notes: Rules for gwylio datecheck, which looks for reports that may have rotted: claims that were true when written and may not be now. A report still in the picture (any state but faded and parked) is flagged when its title, summary or notes use one of these future-framed phrases (matched as whole words, ignoring case), because such a phrase reads wrong once the future arrives; when its event horizon has passed with no history entry since; and when it was last verified more than stale_after_days days ago, or never. Write dated claims instead: 'consultation closes 11 September 2026', not 'consultation closes soon'.
